# Chapter Thirteen: Safe Harbor

Virginia – Two Weeks Earlier

Marcus pulled up to the fence at the address Sowain had given him. He hit the intercom button and a woman’s voice answered “May I help you” she said Marcus took a deep breath and looked back at his ashen faced Alpha. “I was given your address by a friend, a friend who needs help” he said waiting for what seemed like forever for an answer “What is the name of your friend” she asked again in a calm tone, Marcus wanted to snap at her to open the gate, but instead took a deep breath “Sowain, his name is Sowain”. The gates opened a moment later and he took it as his cue to drive in. He followed the driveway up to a main house that quite probably had been a plantation at one time but had fallen on hard times, its paint was peeling and the yard needed tending, but the house looked solid enough. There was a woman waiting for them on the steps, she was tall and blonde wearing a pair of jeans and a t-shirt and sporting a shotgun. Marcus pulled up and got out of the Van and caught a scent on the open air, she was a wolf and an old one too from the smell. At once she caught his scent and recognized one sired by her friend, she lowered the shotgun, “Where is he and how bad” she asked moving towards the van.

Marcus threw open the side door and she gasped as she saw her old friend lying there on the floor of the van. “Get him inside to the couch, now” she commanded as the two younger wolves lifted their Alpha and brought him in the house.

Marcus didn’t know who she was, but Sowain trusted her enough to have them drive him here. And she seemed to know what she was doing. She collected herbs from an old cupboard and began to mix them on the sideboard. Marcus could smell the foul odor “What is that” he said trying not to breathe as the odor permeated everything in the room. The problem with being a being with super smell, is moments like these. The concoction literally made him ill. “This will help him change, he needs to transform in order to force the healing, once we do he will be fine, but I fear if we wait too much longer he won’t come through” she said as she finished stirring and made her way to the couch. She had Rebecca lift his head and hold it while she poured the drink down his throat, he choked a few times and tried to turn his face away, Rebecca caught it and held it in place. It took only 15 minutes and Marcus could see the change starting to occur. Timothy and Rebecca moved him out to the garden to allow him to finish.

“Who are you” Marcus asked with awe, he had never seen anyone be able to force a wolf change much less an alpha, that was impressive he thought. She smiled at Marcus, “a very old friend of your Sire child” she said and then went out to check on Sowain. He had changed and was beginning to stir, standing to his full wolf height of 7 feet as his bones began to reknit and the damage he had taken as a human healed within the wolf. The Alpha let out a howl as it settled into a crouching position and closed its eyes, the nose never stopping as it took in the scents of the night. He began to change back as the wolf finished healing the wounds and he began to regain his strength, tonight wasn’t a night to hunt, tonight he needed answers. Someone had attacked his pack and quite probably killed his line that he had been trying to protect, after living for centuries, he did not believe in coincidence he was sure these acts were perpetrated by the same person. He thought he might know who but he couldn’t believe this person would have tried to have him killed. But he had to find out. As the muscles and bones repositioned bringing him back to his human form Isabella threw a robe at him “So Alfonso, it takes you almost dying to finally come and see me after all this time” she said with a smile on her face, he could see the relief playing across her eyes.

He smiled oh Isabella, it was only an excuse he said nodding a thank you at her. How are the others. He asked looking towards the house “They are well, no worse for wear, Marcus and Patricia gave me the run down, Is it who I think it is behind this” she asked arching an eyebrow at him, her blue eyes glinting the light from the spotlights trained on the yard. “He is calling himself Martin now, but yes I think it was, I don’t believe he intended me dead, but I need to call him and find out, Where is Marcus I need to talk to him before I make the call” Isabella motioned to the house “He is inside probably watching us and wondering who I am” she laughed.

Sowain just smiled “Please call me Sowain in front of the Pack, it has been a long time since I used Alfonso for anything” She nodded in understanding, “However I am still Isabella, being a rogue I don’t have to play the wolf Politics like you do, she punched his arm and then got up” Sowain watched her go as sadness crept across his features, he had known her in her glory days, she had been amazing, the first female Pack Alpha when women were still home in the kitchen. Now to see her like this without a pack or without a family was sad. He had always had a special place in his heart for Isabella and always would, but right now he had to find out what was going on out in the real world, how long had he been down and more importantly what had happened.

He got up and made his way back to the house “Marcus” he said crossing the room and heading into the dining room, his second following close behind. “What do we know” he said sitting at the head of the table and looking over to his Friend and Enforcer. Marcus took a breath “I have talked to the others and pieced together what I could, apparently there was an explosive device in the garage, it was meant to stop us from going on our mission, that’s obvious what’s not obvious is who put it there, but Since Brock is not here nor was his motorcycle at the house when we left, I think it’s obvious he had been compromised and possibly working for another pack. The question is, why was the mission so important and who would have cause to hit us prior to its” He sat down and looked at his Sire waiting for answers, the mission had been mysterious but Sowain always had his reasons, now he needed to share them if Marcus was to help.
